summary: ICL Group Ltd. furnished a Form 6-K incorporating its Q1 2026 investor presentation and earnings release. The filing is a routine periodic report by a foreign private issuer, disclosing financial results and forward-looking statements. It does not announce any special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or abrupt management change. The filing is purely informational and not a special-situations event.
